segments.mature: Women in their late 30s to 50s report visible softening of forehead lines, smile lines, and marionette lines within one to several weeks, often calling it effective for a drugstore-level anti-aging serum.
segments.sensitive: Reviewers who identify as having sensitive or retinol-reactive skin generally report no redness, irritation, or breakouts, though one still avoids daily use out of general retinol caution.
segments.oily: One reviewer with oily skin notes the serum has a mild drying effect at first but considers this acceptable given her oiliness, while others simply note it never feels oily on application.
segments.combination: A reviewer with combination skin reports the serum goes on smoothly, isn't tacky, and addresses pores and wrinkles without issue.
segments.dry: A reviewer with dry skin reports the serum helps fine lines and leaves skin soft and smooth, describing it as working quickly for her dryness.

concerns.aging: The large majority of reviewers, especially those over 35-50, report visibly softer forehead lines, smile lines, marionette lines, and 'elevens' within one week to three months; one reviewer needed three months of daily use to see partial fading of deep frown lines, and a couple simply say results are pending after only a few days.
concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers describe the serum as immediately hydrating, plumping, and non-greasy, leaving skin soft and supple even in dry areas; no reviewer reports increased dryness except one who calls the initial effect mildly drying for oily skin.
concerns.redness: Reviewers report no new redness developing, and one with sensitive skin specifically notes a reduction in pre-existing redness and irritation after use.
concerns.barrier: One reviewer explicitly reports her skin barrier visibly improving after one week of use, alongside reduced dullness.
concerns.spots: Not enough reviewers specifically discuss dark spots or hyperpigmentation to draw a conclusion.
concerns.blemishes: One reviewer states the serum did not break out her face, and no reviewer reports new breakouts or cystic pimples.
concerns.oiliness: Reviewers consistently describe the finish as non-oily, non-greasy, and non-sticky; one reviewer with oily skin appreciated that it wasn't overly oily on her skin type.

extraits.texte: As a mature woman in my 50s, I am always looking for a great serum. The ROC Retinol Correction Line Smoothing Serum has been better than I would have expected from a drug store level brand. The bottle is very pretty and | love the twist and pop-up dispenser. The serum itself is very light and dries quickly. The finish is smooth and not sticky and wears well under my moisturizer. My skin did not develop any redness or dry spots as it has with past retinol products. The lines above my upper lip appear to be a bit fuller and my parentheses seem slightly less deep. I'm very pleased so far with this product and am surprised that I've gotten results so quickly.

Only throwing out 4 stars since I feel I need to use the product longer to get the best results. Pairs well with my sensitive skin, no reactions! Lightweight and quick drying. Great for layering skincare products. I am already a retinol user so first timers may experience different results. So far so good!

I've been using the RoC Retinol line smoothing cream for a few weeks now and I'm genuinely impressed. My skin feels noticeably smoother and looks more even, with fewer fine lines and a brighter tone. It absorbs quickly and doesn't leave a greasy or heavy feeling, so it's easy to layer under my moisturizer or sunscreen. I've also noticed a reduction in redness and irritation, which is a big win for my sensitive skin. The texture is lightweight and feels refreshing, making it a great option for daytime use. It's not harsh, but it still delivers that effective retinol punch I'm looking for. I'm already seeing improvements and feel like my skin is more balanced and youthful. Overall, I'm really happy with this product and would definitely recommend it to anyone looking for a smooth, glowing complexion.

I was so happy to receive and try out this new product by RoC. I have only been using this product for one week and I see a difference in my skin. I am a 41-year-old female, and my skin is looking a little dull and tired. But just after one week of use this product has made my skin feel hydrated, I look more youthful, and I can see my skin barrier improving. I have gotten compliments and my friends have told me my skin looks brighter and less dull, I can't wait to use this product for longer. This product is impressive because 100% have seen visible results (me included), fights 7 signs of aging in just one week and some of the ingredients are clinical retinol, hyaluronic B5 and PDRN.

The brand RoC is pretty well-known in the world of skincare so I was ecstatic to get this as a free sample. Their products intersect the line of effectiveness and price point, and this one is no exception. It sports a whole bunch of benefits: hydration, combats wrinkles, helps with pores, etc. I have combination skin. This product goes on smooth, doesn't feel tacky, and leaves my face feeling nice. Good stuff.

I received this product as a free sample a few days ago and I love it so far! I will say if you have never tried it before to start using it a few times a week because it kind of has a drying affect on your skin. But I was ok with it because my skin is oily. I will continue to use it to see if it works.

This serum is topped tier. I would highly recommend it. It did not break my face out. It felt hydrating and clean, but not over oily. It lasts all day under make it and seems to really help my complexion. I highly recommend this product. Two people, especially with sensitive skin like mine
